failures.explanation: The failing run began by interacting with the PDF/window differently, then took extensive browser navigation detours (directly loading /new, refreshing, and navigating back) instead of following the reference flow. Although it eventually entered the invoice fields, it did not complete the save/attachment workflow, so no invoice was created; this reflects a worse execution strategy rather than task ambiguity or random mis-clicking.

The failing run did not follow the reference workflow for checking and entering the invoice; it opened/closed windows unpredictably, navigated to unrelated system tools, and attempted to inspect or restart the server. This reflects a worse execution strategy rather than ambiguity in the target invoice or a simple timing/mis-click issue.

The failing run identified the same Northstar invoice and entered the correct vendor, invoice number, dates, amounts, and terms, so the task interpretation was consistent. However, it took a substantially different window-management path, repeatedly navigated/reloaded the app, and stopped after attaching/opening the PDF without completing the save; the checker therefore found no new invoice.
